import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def linear_search_lower_bound_precond (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  seq.size ≤ 0x7FFFFFFF ∧
  (∀ i j : Nat, i < j ∧ j < seq.size → seq.getD i 0 ≤ seq.getD j 0)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def lsearch (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) (i : Nat) : Nat :=
  if h : i < seq.size then
    if target ≤ seq.getD i 0 then i else lsearch seq target (i + 1)
  else i
termination_by seq.size - i
decreasing_by omega
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def linear_search_lower_bound (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) (h_precond : linear_search_lower_bound_precond seq target) : Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  lsearch seq target 0
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def linear_search_lower_bound_postcond (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) (result : Nat) (h_precond : linear_search_lower_bound_precond seq target) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result ≤ seq.size ∧
  (∀ i : Nat, i < result → seq.getD i 0 < target) ∧
  (∀ i : Nat, result ≤ i ∧ i < seq.size → seq.getD i 0 ≥ target)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem lsearch_spec (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) :
    ∀ n i, seq.size - i = n → i ≤ seq.size →
      i ≤ lsearch seq target i ∧ lsearch seq target i ≤ seq.size ∧
      (∀ j, i ≤ j → j < lsearch seq target i → seq.getD j 0 < target) ∧
      (lsearch seq target i < seq.size → target ≤ seq.getD (lsearch seq target i) 0) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro i hn hi
    have hEq : i = seq.size := by omega
    subst hEq
    have hnot : ¬ (seq.size < seq.size) := lt_irrefl _
    rw [lsearch.eq_def, dif_neg hnot]
    refine ⟨le_refl _, le_refl _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j hj1 hj2; omega
    · intro h; omega
  | succ n ih =>
    intro i hn hi
    have hlt : i < seq.size := by omega
    rw [lsearch.eq_def, dif_pos hlt]
    by_cases h2 : target ≤ seq.getD i 0
    · rw [if_pos h2]
      refine ⟨le_refl _, hi, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro j hj1 hj2; omega
      · intro _; exact h2
    · rw [if_neg h2]
      obtain ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ := ih (i + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
      refine ⟨by omega, b, ?_, d⟩
      intro j hj1 hj2
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j (i + 1) with hj3 | hj3
      · have hji : j = i := by omega
        subst hji
        exact lt_of_not_le h2
      · exact c j hj3 hj2
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem linear_search_lower_bound_postcond_satisfied (seq : Array Int) (target : Int) (h_precond : linear_search_lower_bound_precond seq target) :
    linear_search_lower_bound_postcond seq target (linear_search_lower_bound seq target h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  unfold linear_search_lower_bound_postcond linear_search_lower_bound
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ := lsearch_spec seq target seq.size 0 (by omega) (by omega)
  refine ⟨b, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    exact c i (Nat.zero_le _) hi
  · intro i hi
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hi
    have hres : lsearch seq target 0 < seq.size := lt_of_le_of_lt h1 h2
    have hge := d hres
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h1 with heq | hlt
    · rw [← heq]; exact hge
    · have hmono := h_precond.2 (lsearch seq target 0) i ⟨hlt, h2⟩
      linarith
  -- !benchmark @end proof
